root_cause: The modal's focus trap (_enforceFocus) only handles forward focus escape via focusin event, but lacks a keydown handler for Shift+Tab backward wrapping. When Shift+Tab is pressed on the first focusable element (#confirm-close), focus should wrap to the last focusable element (#confirm-delete), but no logic intercepts this.
repair_strategy: Add a keydown event listener on the modal element for Tab key that wraps focus bidirectionally: Shift+Tab on first focusable element focuses last, Tab on last focuses first. Register in _enforceFocus (called on show transition complete) and deregister in hide.

edits.after:
const EVENT_KEYDOWN_DISMISS = `keydown.dismiss${EVENT_KEY}`
const EVENT_KEYDOWN_TAB = `keydown.tab${EVENT_KEY}`
const EVENT_MOUSEUP_DISMISS = `mouseup.dismiss${EVENT_KEY}`

expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can navigate the delete confirmation modal bidirectionally with Tab/Shift+Tab, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Minimal - only adds focus wrapping logic; no changes to existing focusin trap, backdrop, or dismissal behavior.
verification_requirements: Run the frozen journey "Move backwards through the delete confirmation" - Shift+Tab from Close button should focus Delete button.
Verify Tab from Delete button wraps to Close button.
